nodes.description: A synonymous WDR19 variant common in Brown Swiss cattle activates a cryptic exonic splice site that removes three conserved amino acids and lowers WDR19 protein. Homozygous bulls are otherwise healthy but have reduced sperm motility, more sperm head and tail anomalies, and lower fertility.
nodes.id: Brown Swiss bull WDR19 cryptic splice allele

evidence.reference_title: Activation of cryptic splicing in bovine WDR19 is associated with reduced semen quality and male fertility.
evidence.snippet: Bioinformatic and transcription analyses revealed that the BTA6:58373887 T-allele activates a cryptic exonic splice site that eliminates three evolutionarily conserved amino acids from WDR19. Western blot analysis demonstrated that the BTA6:58373887 T-allele decreases protein expression.
